Rest API documentation¶

REST API main¶

FastAPI application entry point.

This module initializes and configures the FastAPI application, including CORS middleware, rate limiting, and routing for all API endpoints.

author:

Artur

version:

1.0.0

main.lifespan(app: FastAPI)¶

Application lifespan context manager.

Sets up the rate limiter and initialises the Redis client on application startup. Closes the Redis connection on shutdown.

Parameters:

app (FastAPI) – The FastAPI application instance

async main.rate_limit_handler(request: Request, exc: RateLimitExceeded)¶

Custom rate limit exceeded exception handler.

Parameters:

  • request (Request) – The incoming request

  • exc (RateLimitExceeded) – The rate limit exceeded exception

Returns:

JSON response with error message

JSONResponse

REST API Auth Routes¶

Authentication API routes.

This module provides endpoints for user registration, login, email confirmation, and token management.

author:

Artur

version:

1.0.0

async src.api.auth.confirmed_email(token: str, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), redis: Redis = Depends(dependency=<function get_redis>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Confirm a user’s email address using a verification token.

Decodes the token to extract the email and marks the user as confirmed. Invalidates the Redis cache for the user so the updated data is fetched on the next request.

Parameters:

  • token (str) – Email verification token

  • db (Session) – Database session dependency

  • redis (aioredis.Redis) – Redis client dependency

Returns:

Confirmation message

Return type:

dict

Raises:

HTTPException 400 – If verification token is invalid

async src.api.auth.forgot_password(body: RequestPasswordReset, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Request a password reset email.

If a user with the given email exists, sends a password reset link to that email. Always returns a success message to prevent email enumeration.

Parameters:

  • body (RequestPasswordReset) – Password reset request data

  • background_tasks (BackgroundTasks) – Background tasks manager for sending emails

  • request (Request) – The incoming request object

  • db (Session) – Database session dependency

Returns:

Confirmation message

Return type:

dict

async src.api.auth.login_user(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(dependency=None, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), redis: Redis = Depends(dependency=<function get_redis>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Authenticate a user and return an access token.

Validates the user’s credentials and returns a JWT access token upon successful authentication. The authenticated user is cached in Redis for subsequent requests.

Parameters:

  • form_data (OAuth2PasswordRequestForm) – OAuth2 password form data

  • db (Session) – Database session dependency

  • redis (aioredis.Redis) – Redis client dependency

Returns:

Access token and token type

Return type:

Token

Raises:

HTTPException 401 – If credentials are invalid or email is not confirmed

async src.api.auth.register_user(user_data: UserCreate, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Register a new user.

Creates a new user account with the provided data. Sends a confirmation email to the user’s email address in the background.

Parameters:

  • user_data (UserCreate) – User registration data

  • background_tasks (BackgroundTasks) – Background tasks manager for sending emails

  • request (Request) – The incoming request object

  • db (Session) – Database session dependency

Returns:

The newly created user

Return type:

User

Raises:

HTTPException 409 – If the email or username already exists

async src.api.auth.request_email(body: RequestEmail, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Request a new email confirmation link.

Sends a confirmation email to the specified address if the user exists and has not yet confirmed their email.

Parameters:

  • body (RequestEmail) – Email request data

  • background_tasks (BackgroundTasks) – Background tasks manager for sending emails

  • request (Request) – The incoming request object

  • db (Session) – Database session dependency

Returns:

Confirmation message

Return type:

dict

Raises:

HTTPException 404 – If no user with the given email exists

async src.api.auth.reset_password(token: str, body: ResetPassword, db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), redis: Redis = Depends(dependency=<function get_redis>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Reset a user’s password using a valid reset token.

Decodes the token to extract the email, hashes the new password, and updates the user record. Invalidates the Redis cache for the user.

  • body (ResetPassword) – Reset password data with the new password

  • db (Session) – Database session dependency

  • redis (aioredis.Redis) – Redis client dependency

Returns:

Success message

Return type:

dict

Raises:

HTTPException 400 – If the token or user is invalid

Artur

version:

1.0.0

async src.api.users.me(request: Request, user: User = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_user>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Retrieve the current authenticated user’s profile.

Rate limited to 10 requests per minute.

Parameters:

  • request (Request) – The incoming request object (used by limiter)

  • user (User) – Currently authenticated user

Returns:

The authenticated user’s profile

Return type:

User

async src.api.users.update_avatar_user(file: UploadFile = File(PydanticUndefined), user: User = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_user>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), redis: Redis = Depends(dependency=<function get_redis>, use_cache=True, scope=None), _: bool = Depends(dependency=<src.services.auth.RoleChecker object>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

Update the current user’s avatar image.

Uploads the provided image file to Cloudinary and updates the user’s avatar URL in the database. Invalidates the Redis cache so the updated avatar is returned on subsequent requests.

Admin-only endpoint. Only users with the “admin” role can change their avatar.

Parameters:

  • file (UploadFile) – The uploaded image file

  • user (User) – Currently authenticated user

  • db (AsyncSession) – Database session dependency

  • redis (aioredis.Redis) – Redis client dependency

  • _ (bool) – Admin role check

Returns:

The updated user profile with new avatar URL

Return type:

User

Bases: BaseSettings

Application settings loaded from environment variables.

Configuration class that reads from a .env file and provides typed access to all application configuration values.

Variables:

  • DB_URL – Database connection URL

  • JWT_SECRET – Secret key for JWT token encoding/decoding

  • JWT_ALGORITHM – Algorithm used for JWT tokens (default: HS256)

  • JWT_EXPIRATION_SECONDS – Token expiration time in seconds (default: 3600)

  • MAIL_USERNAME – Email account username

  • MAIL_PASSWORD – Email account password

  • MAIL_FROM – Sender email address

  • MAIL_PORT – SMTP server port (default: 587)

  • MAIL_SERVER – SMTP server hostname

  • MAIL_FROM_NAME – Sender display name

  • MAIL_STARTTLS – Enable STARTTLS (default: True)

  • MAIL_SSL_TLS – Enable SSL/TLS (default: False)

  • USE_CREDENTIALS – Use SMTP credentials (default: True)

  • VALIDATE_CERTS – Validate SSL certificates (default: True)

  • CLOUDINARY_NAME – Cloudinary cloud name

  • CLOUDINARY_API_KEY – Cloudinary API key

  • CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET – Cloudinary API secret

class src.services.auth.RoleChecker(allowed_roles: list[str])¶

Bases: object

FastAPI dependency factory that checks if the authenticated user has one of the allowed roles.

Usage:

@router.get("/admin-only")
async def admin_endpoint(user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
                         _: bool = Depends(RoleChecker(["admin"]))):
    ...
Parameters:

allowed_roles (list[str]) – List of role names that are permitted

async src.services.auth.get_current_user(token: str = Depends(dependency=<fastapi.security.oauth2.OAuth2PasswordBearer object>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: Session = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), redis: Redis = Depends(dependency=<function get_redis>, use_cache=True, scope=None))¶

FastAPI dependency to retrieve the currently authenticated user.

Decodes the JWT token from the Authorization header and fetches the corresponding user from the Redis cache first, falling back to the database if the cache miss occurs.

Parameters:

  • token (str) – JWT access token from the Authorization header

  • db (Session) – Database session dependency

  • redis (aioredis.Redis) – Redis client dependency

Returns:

The authenticated user

Return type:

User

Raises:

HTTPException 401 – If the token is invalid or user not found

The email address stored in the token

str

HTTPException 422 – If the token is invalid
